newsitem.title: CHINA: Newly-listed China firms perform better.
newsitem.headline: Newly-listed China firms perform better.

text.p: Companies listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges since the beginning of 1996 registered better annual results last year than the overall average, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.
The earnings per share in 1996 of 274 newly-listed firms averaged 0.383 yuan while the average for all listed companies was only 0.294 yuan, the newspaper said.
About one-third of the newly-listed firms achieved profit increases in 1996 of more than 50 percent over 1995, it added.
